fact: INSEED presented a restitution session on 24 March 2026 saying 37,449 pastoral and agro-pastoral households were enumerated across 13 provinces into the Registre Social Unifié, and the livestock minister instructed extension to areas not yet covered.

INSEED reports that on 6 January 2026 authorities of N'Djamena's 9th arrondissement were briefed ahead of a household enrolment operation to extend the Registre Social Unifié, with WFP joining the mission.
